acceptance_criteria.description: AboutPage renders a static 'About' section using at least the Card component and the StatusBadge pattern from @small/ui
Imports come only from the @small/ui package root (UI policy gates)
The page is reachable from App.tsx and a component test follows HealthPage.test.tsx patterns

architectural_constraints: Follow the existing patterns and test style of the touched modules
No new dependencies without an explicit operator decision
Frontend-only change; no API calls from the page
